The Tower Fell Down Pip & the Hum Ep1.title: The Tower Fell Down | Pip & the Hum | Feelings Song for Kids & Toddlers
The Tower Fell Down Pip & the Hum Ep1.desc:
Pip's pebble tower keeps falling down — and that feels CROSS! With help from the Hum and Nana Moss, Pip learns that big feelings are okay: you can stomp, take a slow breath, and build again. 🦊✨

For ages 2–6. Calm pacing, gentle sounds and a sing-along song about frustration and trying again.

00:20 The tallest tower
00:40 What's that feeling?

02:01 Try again

For grown-ups: when your little one feels cross, try the Hum's trick together — stomp, breathe in slow, let it go.

The Tower Fell Down Song.title: The Tower Fell Down 🎶 Stomp, Breathe & Try Again | Pip & the Hum Sing-Along
The Tower Fell Down Song.desc:
Pip's pebble tower keeps falling down — and that feels CROSS! Sing along with Pip: stomp, take a slow breath, and build again. 🦊✨

🎶 Lyrics
Stack it up, one, two, three,
Tallest tower you ever did see.
Wobble, wobble... down it goes!
Hot from my ears to the tips of my toes.

When my tower falls down, down, down,
I can stomp, stomp, stomp on the ground.
Then I breathe in slow... and let it go,
And I build it up again!

Every builder's towers fall,
Big ones, small ones, one and all.
Hum a little, wiggle your paws,
Then try again, just because.

When my tower falls down, down, down,
I can stomp, stomp, stomp on the ground.
Then I breathe in slow... and let it go,
And I build it up again!

Breathe in like you smell a flower... hmmmm
Breathe out like you blow a dandelion... whoosh
Hmmm, hmmm, hmmm...

When my tower falls down, down, down,
I can stomp, stomp, stomp on the ground.
Then I breathe in slow... and let it go,
And we build it up again!

For grown-ups: when your little one feels cross, try the Hum's trick together — stomp, breathe in slow, let it go.

Waiting Is Wiggly Pip & the Hum Ep2.title: Waiting Is Wiggly 🌱 Pip & the Hum | Patience Song for Kids
Waiting Is Wiggly Pip & the Hum Ep2.desc:
Pip plants a sunflower seed and wants it to grow RIGHT NOW! Waiting feels wiggly, like ants in your toes. With Nana Moss, little Bo and the Hum, Pip learns a waiting song: wiggle your toes, count to ten, breathe out slow, and look at the world around you while good things grow. 🌻

Sing along with "Waiting Is Wiggly" and practise waiting together.

00:00 A seed 🌻
00:23 Waiting… ⏳
00:38 Bo checks the seed 🦡
00:49 What does waiting feel like?
01:03 Song: Waiting Is Wiggly 🎵
02:03 Look! 🌱
02:12 Hum with me

For grown-ups: this episode helps little ones name impatience and gives them simple things to do while they wait (wiggle, count, breathe, notice).

Waiting Is Wiggly Song.title: Waiting Is Wiggly 🎵 Count to Ten Patience Song | Pip & the Hum
Waiting Is Wiggly Song.desc:
Wiggle your toes, count to ten and breathe out slow! A gentle sing-along about waiting, from Pip & the Hum. 🌱

🎶 Lyrics
Waiting is wiggly, waiting is long,
Wiggle your toes and hum a little song.
Count to ten and breathe out slow,
Little by little, the seeds will grow.

Look at the clouds go drifting by,
Look at the beetle, see it fly!
Smell the flowers, feel the sun,
Waiting can be a little fun.

Waiting is wiggly, waiting is long,
Wiggle your toes and hum a little song.
One, two, three… all the way to ten,
Little by little… now look again!
